verses.1: And David and the leaders of the people separated themselves from serving the children of Asaf and Heman. They were assigned to work in the treasuries, in the chests, and in the storage areas. And so, they became workers who served their masters.
verses.2: The children of Asaf, Zakkur, Yosuf, and Natanya; and the children of Asaf, through Asaf himself, who was brought forth by the king.
verses.3: By their hands were born Gideon, Abiezer, Issaschariah, and Micah. They were raised by their fathers in the Temple, where they offered sacrifices and praised the LORD.
verses.4: To the children of Haiman, they were given names: Matanyahu, Uziel, Shivael, and Virimot Hananya. I have grown up and become strong. Ezer Yashbakasha is my help; Hothir Makhaziyot is also my help.
verses.5: All these sons were born to Haiman. Haiman obeyed the words of God. The Lord gave Haiman fourteen sons and twelve daughters.
verses.6: All these things were done by their ancestors in the Temple of God. They became priests and priestesses who served God. This was done by King Asaph and his followers.
verses.7: And they would sing songs to Jehovah with their brothers. All those who understood the names of these songs knew them well.
verses.8: And they cast their burdens aside, from keeping them as treasures, for the sake of those who are small and insignificant, compared to those who are great.
verses.9: And the first priest went out to gather Josaphat, Gideon the second, and his sons and grandsons, a total of twenty people.
verses.10: The third one remembered his children and brothers—twelve in total.
verses.11: The fourth son was born to his father and brothers; there were twenty-two sons in total.
verses.12: The fifth child was given to him by his sons and brothers; there were twenty-two children in total.
verses.13: His sons and brothers numbered twenty-two in total.
verses.14: There are fifty sons and brothers among Israel’s descendants, twenty in total.
verses.15: The eighth was Yeshua’hu, along with his sons and brothers, a total of twelve in number.
verses.16: The seventh son was killed by his own sons and brothers; there were twenty-two of them.
verses.17: The rich man had twenty sons and brothers.
verses.18: Ashtéy-‘Azarel had twelve sons and twelve brothers.
verses.19: The twelve years were counted as belonging to his sons and brothers.
verses.20: There were thirteen sons and twelve brothers.
verses.21: There were fourteen daughters and twelve sons in his family.
verses.22: Thirty and ten were born to his sons and brothers; twenty were also born.
verses.23: In the year forty, his sons and brothers numbered twenty.
verses.24: In seventeen years, their sons and brothers will also be able to sit down.
verses.25: For his sake, my ten sons and brothers were sacrificed.
verses.26: For the eleven years of my reign, his sons and brothers numbered twenty-one.
verses.27: There were forty sons and brothers to Eliah.
verses.28: One hundred and twenty, to spare their children and brothers. Twenty-two.
verses.29: For two and twenty years, I grew up with their children and brothers. They were twenty in number.
verses.30: Thirty and twenty for their sons and brothers; twenty-two in total.
verses.31: For forty and twenty, I had help from my sons and brothers; there were twenty-two in total.
